editor_provenance.attribution_note: The actual collaboration tool was invoked once with the requested selector and fresh context. Immutable provider identity, accepted effort, usage and technical isolation are not independently verified.
editor_provenance.charged_local_seconds_scope: Sum of study action-ledger charges through candidate packaging, including profile maintenance, editor elapsed time, import, build, conversion and packaging. This is not provider token usage, billing, or target-inference compute.
editor_provenance.pre_evaluation_rationale: Intervention: R4 stronger V1-support attenuation. From pristine, scale columns 0–59 of both layer 15 and layer 19 MLP down-projection weights by 0.5. This tests a stronger dose on the only support with a fresh net strict-compliance gain; the other tested supports changed length without improving aggregate compliance. I predict a small chance of exceeding 17/32, with 16–18/32 a plausible central range, rather than a dependable improvement. V1's extra pass came from repetitive highlighting, so it is weak evidence of genuine instruction-following improvement. The intended effect is improved constraint adherence while preserving existing passes, not inducing repetition. Output tokens may remain near pristine or decline, but could rise. I expect essentially unchanged allocation sizes and no reliable per-token resource improvement; cumulative work depends on generated length. These are uncertain predictions on exposed development data, with no neuron-semantic claim or generalization evidence.

label: Fresh baseline and fourth Astra edit
limitations: All 32 quality prompts were previously exposed; adaptive development evidence, not untouched confirmation.
One quality run per artifact and two resource sessions on one device; no significance or resource-equivalence claim.
Mirrored resource order balances linear ordinal drift, not arbitrary elapsed-time or host-condition changes.
CPU/GPU activity rates are not cumulative compute; allocation descriptors are not physical VRAM; missing power remains null.
Session throughput ratios are averaged equally, not pooled across sessions.
Historical studies and ledgers remain unchanged.

compiled_parameter_metadata.method: Direct parse from unchanged verified compiled WASM; not an unverified historical JSON copy

notes: All preparation used zero target-model calls. Exact source bytes and deployed artifacts were verified before the first model load.

The converter was reconstructed from 75 same-version cached wheels. Wheel RECORD digests and available installed RECORD digests were checked; 27 historical installed RECORDs were unavailable, so full old-environment byte equality is not claimed.
Ten new local library copies received signature-only ad-hoc signing, with unchanged code/data payloads verified; three readable historical signed libraries matched byte for byte.
The 435-parameter metadata was extracted from the unchanged, verified compiled WASM; equality to the unavailable historical JSON bytes is not claimed.

Preparation rejected 73 extra language files in the new tokenizer staging and a converter executable symlink. The English-only allowlist and explicit interpreter selector/binary/config binding were corrected before freezing; original inputs were preserved.
Earlier console-script and signature-metadata preparation failures were preserved. All failed preparation and accounting amendments are included in conservative local elapsed-time charges.

objectives.resource_eligibility: All technically valid artifacts measured regardless of quality; no retrospective gate.

counter_definitions.coverage: Original collector coverage fractions/records retained. Missing signals and excluded intervals are not treated as zero.
counter_definitions.cpu_capacity_percent: Original interval-weighted CPU percentage of total logical-CPU capacity during profile active-phase windows; partial/boundary-crossing intervals excluded.
counter_definitions.full_response_tokens_per_second: Measured sampled output tokens / total full-response seconds. Not decode-only throughput.
counter_definitions.gpu_buffer_descriptor_bytes_sampled_max: Maximum sampled GPUBuffer allocation descriptors; not physical VRAM.
counter_definitions.gpu_time_ms_per_second: Experimental AGX driver-accounted command-buffer milliseconds per second for the owned Chrome process tree, including rendering. Concurrent queues may overlap; not GPU utilization/capacity, shader occupancy or model-only GPU time.
counter_definitions.host_power_watts: Host-wide observed power, only if captured; unavailable in unprivileged capture, never zero-filled.
counter_definitions.mean_response_ms: Sum of measured full-response milliseconds divided by measured requests; warm-up excluded.
counter_definitions.native_idle_footprint_gb: Median owned process-tree footprint in the original final loaded-idle window, decimal GB.
counter_definitions.native_peak_footprint_gb: Sampled maximum owned Chrome process-tree physical footprint, decimal GB (1e9 bytes); shared memory may be counted across processes. Not dedicated model memory or physical VRAM.
counter_definitions.native_recovery_footprint_gb: Median owned process-tree footprint in the original recovery window, decimal GB.
counter_definitions.response_ms_per_output_token: Total measured full-response milliseconds / sampled output tokens. Null for no output tokens.
counter_definitions.wasm_address_space_bytes_sampled_max: Maximum sampled WASM address space; not resident physical memory.

energy.note: Five seconds of observed pre-run baseline when available. Integrate power over overlap with active time; missing intervals are not filled. Above-baseline energy is a host change, not causal attribution to the model.
energy.scope: Host CPU+GPU+ANE subsystem estimate; not device wall power or model-attributed energy

native_coverage.label: Browser process-tree CPU
native_coverage.reason: RUSAGE_INFO CPU counters are Mach absolute ticks, converted using mach_timebase_info. Delta own user+system CPU nanoseconds / elapsed monotonic nanoseconds * 100. 100% = one logical CPU; capacity percent divides by logical CPU count. Child CPU totals are never added again. Incomplete process intervals are null in charts; raw partial values retained.
native_coverage.source: libproc own CPU ticks → mach_timebase_info → interval delta

native_coverage.label: Accounted process footprint
native_coverage.reason: Footprint is the sum of per-process kernel-accounted phys_footprint values, not a globally deduplicated physical-memory measurement. RSS is retained per process and summed only as a labeled non-deduplicated statistic; shared pages may be counted repeatedly. Never add browser WASM/GPU buffer sizes to either OS metric.

native_coverage.label: GPU activity
native_coverage.reason: Driver-reported device activity across all applications; sampling window is driver-defined. Not benchmark-only GPU use.

native_coverage.label: Chrome GPU time (experimental)
native_coverage.reason: Driver-accounted command-buffer time for the dedicated Chrome process tree, including browser rendering. Approximate nanosecond accounting, not shader occupancy, reserved GPU cores, or model-only utilization. Concurrent queues may overlap, so time per second is not a capacity percentage. Undocumented Apple driver property: availability and semantics may change. Client/PID changes, queue changes, regressions and read failures create gaps. AppUsage has no stable queue identifiers; positional continuity checks are best effort.

native_coverage.label: Thermal pressure
native_coverage.reason: 0 nominal, 1 fair, 2 serious, 3 critical. This is pressure, not temperature in degrees.

native_coverage.label: Memory pressure and swap
native_coverage.reason: Host pressure level is a raw kernel category; swap is host-wide. Free pages are not total available/reclaimable memory.

native_coverage.label: Estimated CPU / GPU / ANE power
native_coverage.reason: No usable powermetrics samples overlap this run. Requires administrator-authenticated bounded capture; absence is not zero watts.
